Stop the Shakedown!

United Against Kings

We are Not For Sale!

Please join us for an organizing zoom call ahead of our third town hall leg in Eastern Idaho. During the 2025 legislative session, Idaho lawmakers passed House Bill 93 and enacted a $50 million school-voucher program. For the first time in state history, Idaho tax dollars will be used to subsidize the cost of tuition for private-school families. 

The special-interest groups promoting vouchers have made clear that the $50 million program is only the beginning. During next year’s legislative session, they intend to remove the $50-million cap and expand the program to all private-school families, including the wealthy, at an estimated cost of $339 million per year.
 
Such a massive expansion of vouchers would bankrupt Idaho and drain millions from public schools. For the benefit of a small number of private-school families, it would defund the public education system that serves 94% of Idaho’s kids. 

It may be inevitable that the legislature tries to expand House Bill 93, but it is not inevitable that they will succeed. To stop this attack on public schools, we need to get organized. Please sign up if you can make it and we hope to see you soon!

title: Estate Planning 101 With Attorney Jacquelyne J. Mingle
description:
Most people know that having a will is important. Still, many don’t have one. But get this: Having just a will is often not enough. Without crucial documents, people are leaving themselves and their estates vulnerable. Join Sky Island Alliance and Tucson attorney Jacquelyne J. Mingle to learn estate planning basics and a bit more. This free public event is brought to you by [Sky Island Alliance](https://skyislandalliance.org/), [Planned Giving Roundtable of Southern Arizona](https://www.pgrtsa.org/), and [Mission Management & Trust Co](https://missiontrust.com/). 

**About Our Speaker**

Jacquelyne J. Mingle has been practicing in Tucson for more than a decade, and her practice encompasses a variety of elder law issues, including estate planning; estate and trust administration; and disputes over wills, trusts, and estates. She is a fellow of the American College of Trust and Estate Counsel, is one of U.S. News & World Report’s “Best Lawyers,” and is certified by the State Bar of Arizona as a Specialist in Estate and Trust Law. She is licensed as a fiduciary by the Arizona Supreme Court and served as chair of the State Bar’s Elder Law, Mental Health and Special Needs Planning Council and served on the Estate & Trust Law Advisory Commission for the State Bar’s Board of Legal Specialization. She also serves on the board of directors for the Southern Arizona Estate Planning Council and Tohono Chul Park. Jacque’s J.D. is from the U of A’s James E. Rogers College of Law, where she has taught the Trusts & Estates course as an adjunct professor. Before becoming an attorney, Jacque was an editor at USA Today supervising entertainment coverage. She did her undergraduate work at the University of Kansas and roots for both the Jayhawks (Rock Chalk!) and the Wildcats (Bear Down!).

description:

Rachel Maddow has frequently invited him back on her show to explain how we can make sense of the current moment. ([Here is one appearance earlier this year](https://youtu.be/nNrbInmlHhA?si=zTCn8t-kXWaP5tJ9)). This book is more relevant than ever. Many of the warnings in the book are unfolding before our eyes right now. So, it's crucial to know how to recognize these signs, and more importantly, what we can learn from history and do differently this time.

The book is fairly short, only 126 pages, and would take just 2-3 hours to finish. If you need to purchase a copy, consider buying from a local bookstore.

NO KINGS is a national day of action and mass mobilization in response to increasing authoritarian excesses and corruption from Trump and his allies. We’ve watched as they’ve cracked down on free speech, detained people for their political views, threatened to deport American citizens, and defied the courts. They’ve done this all while continuing to serve and enrich their billionaire allies.


🚨**On Saturday, June 14, we’re taking to the streets nationwide. We’re not gathering to feed his ego. We’re building a movement that leaves him behind.**🚨


The flag doesn’t belong to Donald Trump. It belongs to us. We’re not watching history happen. We’re making it.


**On June 14th, we’re showing up everywhere he isn’t—to say no thrones, no crowns, no kings.**
Check out nokings.org for more information.

*A core principle behind all No Kings events is a commitment to nonviolent action. We expect all participants to seek to de-escalate any potential confrontation with those who disagree with our values.*
accessibility_notes: This event will be held outside, on a public sidewalk. Public parking available, with Handicap parking spaces.
